scientific_integrity: The analytical proof establishes the stated identities for all quantified parameters; the bundled finite experiments are diagnostic only, not proofs of infinite expectations. No independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for a fixed one-dimensional real Galerkin trial space, a symmetric positive-definite generator and independent Gaussian sketch entries only.

The frozen-exact-flow infinite positive-time moments are unconditional: conditioning on a good embedding, regularizing the denominator, finite precision, and continuously resampled ODEs are outside the theorem.
The explicit-Euler statements compare repeated use of one sketch with independent per-step sketches, not variable trial spaces or higher-rank matrix low-rank integrators.

The exact Student law, Student moment criterion, and Gaussian fixed-vector sign-loss facts are acknowledged prior ingredients; the assessed finding is the complete fixed-versus-fresh time-propagation moment frontier.
Scientific originality remains exposed to unindexed or inaccessible related literature; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: A sharp moment-stability frontier for Gaussian-sketched Galerkin decay
